digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Venezuela después del pacto petrolero con EE. UU.. Asia-Pacific carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर यूरोप और रूस की अगुवाई है, जहां भारत से टकराया था पाकिस्तानी जहाज, अब उसी अरब सागर में 10 दिन बारूद बरसाएगा पाकिस्तान मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Venezuela después del pacto petrolero con EE. UU.
articles.summary: La administración Trump ha anunciado un acuerdo con Caracas que, según dice, otorga a EE. UU. una participación importante en la industria petrolera venezolana. En esta sesión de preguntas y respuestas, los expertos de Crisis Group Phil Gunson y Delaney Simon analizan las repercusiones de dicho acuerdo. Venezuela después del pacto petrolero con EE.

articles.title: China’s J-36 may soon fly with lasers the US couldn’t master
articles.summary: Recent revelations from China’s defense industry suggest the long-sought goal of mounting combat lasers onto fighter aircraft may finally be moving from theory to reality. State-owned aerospace contractor Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) showcased plans for an airborne directed-energy weapon at a defense expo, offering the strongest public indication yet that China is developing [] T China’s J-36 may soon fly with lasers the US couldn’t master.

articles.title: ASEAN’s digital payment boom outrunning its scam defenses
articles.summary: Southeast Asia’s rapid economic integration has long been a celebrated success story, and nowhere is this more evident today than in its retail payment systems. Across the region, central banks are linking their national QR code protocols under the ASEAN Regional Payment Connectivity initiative, enabling friction-free, cross-border digital transactions between citizens of Indonesia, Thailand, Mala ASEAN’s digital payment boom outrunning its scam defenses.

articles.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
articles.summary: After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millionsNo one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane whe.

articles.title: New party emerges as a frontrunner as Israel goes to polls amid Netanyahu’s waning appeal
articles.summary: Yashar leads in opinion polls as its leader Gadi Eisenkot’s popularity among voters eclipses that of Netanyahu; Eisenkot bats for strategic wars over endless ones and concurs with the PM on matter such as two-state solution and Iran New party emerges as a frontrunner as Israel goes to polls amid Netanyahu’s waning appeal.

articles.title: Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions
articles.summary: Two leaders meet in French territory off Canada as Ottawa seeks stronger relations with EU while fighting trade war with USThe leaders of France and Canada have pledged closer ties to grapple with rising geopolitical tensions, climate change and the erosion of democratic values, after ⁠they met in a ⁠French territory off Canada’s Atlantic coast. Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions.

articles.title: Russia's Parliamentary Vote Ends As Moscow, Kyiv Continue Fighting
articles.summary: There was no let up in fighting between Russia and Ukraine on September 20, as voters in Russia cast ballots on the final day of parliamentary elections from which a political party calling for peace was excluded. Russia's Parliamentary Vote Ends As Moscow, Kyiv Continue Fighting.

articles.title: Michelle Bachelet withdraws from race to become UN secretary general
articles.summary: Former president of Chile drops out after support collapsed in security council straw poll, leaving seven candidates in contestMichelle Bachelet, a former president of Chile, has withdrawn her candidacy to become the next secretary general of the ⁠UN, ending an attempt ​that had struggled to gain traction among security council members. Michelle Bachelet withdraws from race to become UN secretary general.

articles.title: The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right
articles.summary: Compare two children born in the same year: one in a country with functioning schools, social services, fair elections and a dynamic economy and the other in a nation devastated by poverty, conflict, climate change or corruption. The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right.

articles.title: Afghan Minaret Restoration Marks 'Pragmatic' Taliban Approach To Cultural Heritage, Experts Say
articles.summary: Work is now underway to the restore Afghanistan's Minaret of Jam, which experts say reflects a welcome departure from the icon-smashing rule of the Taliban of the 1990s. The change contrasts with the current Taliban rulers' draconian restrictions on other facets of life in the country. Afghan Minaret Restoration Marks 'Pragmatic' Taliban Approach To Cultural Heritage, Experts Say.

articles.title: Russia's Starlink Rival Faces Problems In Orbit And Threats On The Ground
articles.summary: Russia is racing to build Rassvet, its answer to Starlink, after losing access to the satellite network on the battlefield in Ukraine. But troubled satellites, tight deadlines, and a lack of ground terminals could leave Moscow waiting years. Russia's Starlink Rival Faces Problems In Orbit And Threats On The Ground.

articles.title: Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development
articles.summary: Beijing believes slowdown calls aim to lock in US advantage, and is pursuing a different balance between safety and paceAbout two years ago, education entrepreneur Boris But had what he calls a “penny-drop moment” – that, like countless others in China, his company needed to embrace AI before it was made obsolete by it. Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development.

articles.title: China pairs undersea drone mothership with multidomain war vision
articles.summary: China is constructing what may be the world’s first dedicated mothership for extra-extra-large uncrewed underwater vehicles (XXLUUVs) at the Hudong-Zhonghua shipyard in Shanghai, multiple outlets reported. Satellite photos show the roughly 200-meter hull features a large internal hangar. likely capable of stowing up to four autonomous submersibles. and an open-bottom stern well-deck fitted [] T China pairs undersea drone mothership with multidomain war vision.

articles.title: Trump Signs Russia-Iran Sanctions Bill, Putting New Pressure Tools At His Disposal
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump signed into law legislation aimed at increasing economic pressure on Russia over its war on Ukraine, including by targeting Moscow's energy revenues as well as countries that continue to buy Russian oil and gas. Trump Signs Russia-Iran Sanctions Bill, Putting New Pressure Tools At His Disposal.

articles.title: US-Saudi F-35 fighter deal runs into a China-sized problem
articles.summary: A potential multi-billion-dollar transfer of advanced US stealth fighters to Saudi Arabia has thrust US Middle East policy into a delicate balancing act between regional deterrence, Israeli air superiority and rising geopolitical skepticism. The US State Department approved a potential US$24.3 billion Foreign Military Sale (FMS) of 48 Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II fighter jets [] The post US- US-Saudi F-35 fighter deal runs into a China-sized problem.

articles.title: Suicide Attack On Police Facility In Northwest Pakistan Leaves Many Dead And Wounded
articles.summary: At least 16 people were reported dead and dozens were injured after an attacker drove a vehicle packed with explosives into a police complex in Pakistan. Officials said several other attackers died in a shootout with police after the blast in the city of Kohat in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. Suicide Attack On Police Facility In Northwest Pakistan Leaves Many Dead And Wounded.

articles.title: Brazil’s Lula announces higher welfare payments and free weight-loss jabs ahead of election
articles.summary: Critics say moves from leftwing incumbent president are electorally motivated two weeks before Brazil’s electionsBrazil’s president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has announced a 15% increase in the country’s main cash-transfer programme for poor families, as well as free weight-loss jabs, prompting criticism from opponents who say the moves are electorally motivated just two weeks before the preside Brazil’s Lula announces higher welfare payments and free weight-loss jabs ahead of election.

articles.title: Technology is transforming crime – and the response to it
articles.summary: Sitting in her Vienna office ahead of a pivotal UN gathering in Abu Dhabi, Monica Juma is focused on a simple reality: crime has evolved faster than many of the institutions designed to combat it. Technology is transforming crime – and the response to it.

articles.title: ‘Violence will only defer a problem’: UN Assembly President on trust, AI and lessons from the
articles.summary: Khalilur Rahman took the gavel as President of the UN General Assembly's 81st session amid what he calls a crisis of confidence in the organization he has served – in one capacity or another – for 35 years. ‘Violence will only defer a problem’: UN Assembly President on trust, AI and lessons from the.

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: UN peacekeeping under pressure
articles.summary: UN peacekeepers have increasingly been sent into places where there is no peace to keep – under resourced, outgunned and exposed to violence they are not equipped to counter. The Security Council meets this afternoon in New York to confront that problem, with Secretary-General António Guterres briefing ambassadors on how to close the gap. Security Council LIVE: UN peacekeeping under pressure.

articles.title: Women and girls pay high price in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
articles.summary: The deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has taken a disproportionate toll on women and girls, many of whom are on the frontlines caring for patients as well as their own families despite the high risk of infection. Women and girls pay high price in DR Congo Ebola outbreak.

articles.title: Child malnutrition crisis worsens amid escalating violence
articles.summary: Haiti is facing a worsening child malnutrition crisis, with an estimated 253,725 children aged 6 to 59 months projected to suffer from acute malnutrition between June 2026 and May 2027, new UN-backed analysis has revealed. Child malnutrition crisis worsens amid escalating violence.

articles.title: Thunderstorms hit Spain as Japan braces for typhoon
articles.summary: At least one person dead as stormy weather causes severe flooding in Barcelona and Valencia Intense and slow-moving thunderstorms broke out on Wednesday afternoon across parts of eastern Spain, bringing some severe flooding and killing at least one person. Storms first struck over the Castilla-La Mancha region during the afternoon before passing over Spain’s east coast, becoming very slow-moving an Thunderstorms hit Spain as Japan braces for typhoon.

articles.title: South Korea will not send military to support US war on Iran, defying Trump pressure
articles.summary: Seoul resolves recent speculation over sending military to strait of Hormuz, saying ‘there won’t be deployment that would involve or enter war’South Korea’s president, Lee Jae Myung, has said he will ⁠not deploy the military to the ⁠Middle East in a way ​that could draw the country into conflict, resisting calls from Donald Trump to support his war in Iran.

articles.title: A Pivotal Moment in Uniting Post-Assad Syria
articles.summary: The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces, which long enjoyed de facto autonomy in north-eastern Syria, have dissolved. But tensions in the region remain high as talks about integration with the central state proceed. Further compromise would set a useful precedent for other parts of the country. A Pivotal Moment in Uniting Post-Assad Syria.

articles.summary: Iran Nuclear Deal: ईरान के परमाणु कार्यक्रम को लेकर अमेरिका ने अपना रुख और स्पष्ट कर दिया है। संयुक्त राष्ट्र में अमेरिकी राजदूत माइक वॉल्ट्ज ने कहा है कि राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप का लक्ष्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि ईरान कभी परमाणु हथियार हासिल न कर सके। इसके लिए वॉशिंगटन ‘अधिकतम दबाव’ जारी रखेगा। हालांकि, इसी कड़े संदेश के बीच तेहरान के लिए बातचीत का रास्ता खुला रखा गया है।
